stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Aquatica
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Subnautica inspired underwater style! Cobbled DioCrete Hell Garunteed! REQUIRES a Deep Ocean to start.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: High Magic
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: A mystical style powered by crystals! Watch as your colonists build crystals and power their buildings

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Antique
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Sent out by the gods themselves to spread their cult, you venture out to create the most thriving Greek colony the world has ever seen! This style makes heavy use of birch and calcite blocks and is therefore best used in a forest or mountain.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Steampunk
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Steampunk, Big and Challenging! 'copper hell' - Sapph

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Functional Fantasy
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Modern architecture and fantasy. Escape proof animal pens and a fire breathing dragon

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Hive
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Bee-lieve in yourself and build the sweetest home! A complex connected style ideal for hanging in open spaces.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: FairyTale
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: A town within a magical forest with a secret hidden within the past, present, and future.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Farthest Frontier
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: [Advanced] Based on the strategy game, Farthest Frontier, protect and guide your people as you forge a town from untamed wilderness at the edge of the known world.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Crimson Keep
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: A modular keep that is kinda expensive

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Underwater Base
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Exploit the treasures hidden in the DEEPEST oceans. Prepare yourself to clean-up an ocean monument to succeed! Try to settle with in a 20 blocks (at least) deep ocean.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Tropical
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Get the Beach Towels and enjoy the Beach. Tropical is a stilt based style to be placed above shallow water.

stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.name: Frontier
stylecolonies_audit_only_packs.description: Frontier, your home on the range!
